{{Quote|They took the droids, the harvesters. And when that wasn't enough... they took slaves. My daughter, every woman here, my neighbors' wives and kids. The pirates carried them off like livestock!|Danbar Hue|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Lela Hue''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] daughter of [[Danbar Hue]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] raided several moisture farms near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], including [[Chuaro Farmstead|Danbar Hue's farm]], and took females as prisoners, to be shipped as slaves off-world. However, Danbar Hue hired Republic citizens to attack the [[Twin Sun pirates base|pirate base]] and liberate the captives and as a result all prisoners, including Lela, were able to return to their homes safely.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lela Hue appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Search and Rescue" on Tatooine.<ref name="SWTOR" />
